row.notes: Returns early when the component vector element+0x30..+0x38 already holds one of type 0x146ca59b0. Otherwise allocates a 0x128-byte component (vtable 0x14588d9d0) from g_Vm_UiSystem, inits the binding at +0x18, copies source_path to the NeStr at +0x120, sets callback 0x1442b3680, attaches it (vslot 0x20), stores scope at +0x10 with listener 0x1442b31e0, calls Vm_Binding_SetSourceAndResolve(binding, path, scope+0xb0 or registry root) and Vm_Binding_ResolveAndSubscribe when element+0xa bit 0x10 is set; with propagate it calls 0x144248c20(element, scope, 1) and 0x14424b050 on the children in [element+0x18]. Finally inserts the component at the front of the element component vector. Callers: Vm_ElementBase_Init 0x144202160 passes the path read from prop 0x289bf23c, or a null path when bool prop 0xc40abcfc is set; 0x143839940 and 0x14423fa30 (set-scope style handlers that scan the components first) pass constant path 0x14588d29d and their scope argument.
